Maison Privée.title: Maison Privée
Maison Privée.summary: Two luxury CapitaLand apartment towers inside the Ciputra urban area: 490 apartments, 68 amenities, a private supercar garage, WELL certification target, handover expected in Q4 2029.
overview: Maison Privée is CapitaLand Development's new high-rise residential project in Hanoi, developed with two Japanese partners, Mitsubishi Estate and Nomura Real Estate. It sits on plot CT07-CT1 in the Nam Thăng Long (Ciputra) urban area, Phú Thượng Ward — one of the longest-established and best-planned international urban areas west of West Lake.
The project comprises two 35-storey towers on a site of about 8,087 m² with a building density of 35%. Tower M has 308 apartments, from 2 bedrooms up to penthouses. Tower P — carrying its own name,
Maison Privée Reserve
— has 182 apartments of 3 bedrooms and above, every one with a private elevator lobby, plus high-ceilinged "Sky Maison" duplexes and penthouses at the top of the tower.

The 68 amenities are spread across many levels: a garden and arrival lobby on level 1, a dedicated Wellness Suite floor on level 2, a family living area on level 3, sky gardens on levels 13 and 20, and The Crest infinity pool on level 35. The project has a showcase garage for residents and a 1:1 car parking ratio.

Maison Privée targets WELL for Residential certification (pre-certification) — with filtered fresh-air supply for Tower P, whole-building water filtration and low-VOC paint materials. Apartments are handed over fully finished with fittings from European brands such as Franke, V-ZUG, Villeroy & Boch, Gessi, Geberit and Axor.

The architecture is by P&T Group (Singapore), the interiors by Steve Leung Design and PTANG Studio (Hong Kong), and the landscape by Redland-Scape (Thailand). Construction is expected to start in Q3 2026, with handover expected in Q4 2029.

Astor 1.title: Astor 1
Astor 1.summary: A 40-storey Art Deco apartment tower on plot IA25 of the Nam Thăng Long (Ciputra) urban area: 350 apartments from studios to penthouses, 25 on-site amenities, operated by CBRE.
overview: Astor 1 is a high-rise apartment tower on plot IA25 in the Nam Thăng Long (Ciputra) urban area, Phú Thượng Ward, Hanoi. The project is developed by Pristie, designed by Stellar, built by Delta Construction Group as general contractor, with CBRE in charge of operations and management.

The building has 40 above-ground floors and 2 basement levels on a 0.36 ha site, with a building density of about 37%. The architecture is inspired by Art Deco, with a 9 m-high main lobby. All 350 apartments are laid out so that both the unit and its bedrooms receive natural light and breezes.

The range runs from studios and 2–3 bedroom units to 5-bedroom Dual Key units, plus duplexes and garden penthouses on the upper floors. The 25 on-site amenities include a year-round pool, a wellness area, gym and yoga, a Kids Club, 3D golf, a library, a clubhouse and about 3,000 m² of greenery.

Apartments are handed over fully finished with built-in fittings, including a dishwasher, a HEPA-filtered heat-recovery ventilation system, RO water filtration and a smart-home package. Residents also enjoy the existing amenities of the Ciputra urban area, such as the golf course, international schools, hospitals and parks. The project is expected to be handed over in Q1 2029.

The Windsor Collection.title: The Windsor Collection
The Windsor Collection.summary: A collection of British-style lake-island residences within Ciputra Hanoi's 66 ha park: 140 villas and townhouses in two lines, The Elton Series and Everbloom.
overview: The Windsor Collection is the low-rise land bank in the core of the Ciputra Hanoi urban area (Nam Thăng Long), Phú Thượng Ward — an international urban area of more than 300 ha with a resident community from many countries.

The project lies on two peninsulas, Bình Minh and Hoàng Hôn, surrounded by a retention lake of about 26 ha within an overall park and water area of about 66 ha. A low building density of about 14% gives most homes a view over the lake or the park.
Phase 1 has 140 low-rise homes divided into three subdivisions:
The Royal
The Hyde
(BT8-9) and
The Regent
(Q2). The products belong to two lines:
The Elton Series
— "compact luxury" townhouses and semi-detached homes with a plot area from 144 m²; and
Everbloom Series
— detached lake-island residences with plot areas from 300 m² to over 1,000 m².

The architecture draws on classic British style, designed by P&T Group and Kaze Studio; the show-home interiors are by 1508 London and the landscape by LJ Group. Townhouses have 4 above-ground floors plus a mezzanine or rooftop room and 1 basement; villas have 3 above-ground floors, a rooftop room and a basement. Homes are handed over in shell condition with a finished exterior.

Residents use the lakeside amenities such as Club Windsor House, The Raffles retail and office zone, a plaza, themed gardens and a year-round pool, along with Ciputra's existing amenities such as the golf course, international schools and Ciputra Club.
